summary: Iteration 28 frontend regression: persistent pagination across polling refetches, per-card PhotoTile error placeholder, and Lightbox blackout/aspect/scroll-lock/directional-slide changes. One critical import bug was discovered (WorksPage crashed with `prefetchImageUrls is not defined` runtime error, breaking /works entirely) and fixed by the testing agent. After the fix, ALL Iteration-28 acceptance criteria pass on both /works and /gallery.
action_items: None from testing agent — the missing prefetchImageUrls import in WorksPage.jsx has already been added by the tester. Main agent should verify the tiny 1-line import diff is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: WorksPage.jsx used `prefetchImageUrls` in FolderCards hover-prefetch but forgot to import it (GalleryPage had it correct). Caused an Uncaught ReferenceError on /works render — fixed by tester: `import { useGallery, prefetchImageUrls } from '../lib/useGallery';`.

useGalleryPreloader.js effect depends on `photos` array reference — since useGallery polling returns new array refs every 20s, the preloader will re-run each cycle even when photos are identical. The `_prefetched` Set guard in prefetchImageUrls saves the network cost, so this is benign, but a `photoIdKey` memo dependency would be cleaner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on live preview URL. /works RESIDENTIAL → Hall & Dining folder has 15+ photos and renders pagination. /gallery Hall & Dining folder same. Pagination testids: `works-child-pagination-page-{n}` (Works) and `gallery-pagination-page-{n}` (Gallery). Lightbox testids: `portfolio-lightbox*` for /works, `gallery-lightbox*` for /gallery. PhotoTile placeholder verified via `imgs[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('error'))` — placeholder rendered without unmounting neighbours (14 remaining + 1 placeholder = 15 slots).

verified_features.pagination_persistence_works: click page 2 → 02, focus refetch → 02, 22s natural poll → 02
verified_features.photo_id_hash_reset: Switching folders correctly re-renders (target folder had no pagination, verified independent state)
verified_features.photo_tile_error_placeholder: class='w-full animate-pulse', bg #EAE8E3, aspect-ratio 3/4, min-height 220px, role=img, aria-label='Image unavailable', neighbours intact
verified_features.lightbox_backdrop: bg-black/95 + backdrop-blur-md confirmed on both portfolio and gallery lightboxes; no bg-black/90 or backdrop-blur-xl remnants
verified_features.lightbox_body_scroll_lock: document.body.style.overflow='hidden' while open, restored to '' after close
verified_features.lightbox_directional_slide: Inline transforms observed: next→translateX(60px) enter, prev→translateX(-60px) enter; counter updates 01→02→01
